national.canonicalTopic: India finishes fourth at Pickleball World Cup
national.headline: India wins 41 medals and finishes fourth at Pickleball World Cup
facts: India finished fourth among 82 countries at the fourth Pickleball World Cup in Da Nang, Vietnam, held from 2026-08-30 to 2026-09-06.
India won 41 medals: 7 gold, 17 silver and 17 bronze, improving from seventh place in the previous edition.
Vietnam topped the standings with 271 medals; South Korea placed second and the USA third.
India’s boys’ team, led by Veer Shah, won silver; Shah was named Best Captain.
The event was conducted with the sanction of the World Pickleball Federation.
national.summary: India placed fourth at the 2026 Pickleball World Cup, winning 41 medals across the competition.
national.staticLink: Pickleball combines elements of tennis, badminton and table tennis and uses a solid paddle and perforated plastic ball.
national.prelimsTakeaway: India’s medal tally was 7 gold, 17 silver and 17 bronze.
